╭──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── step 3 of 5 ─╮
│                                                                              │
│  Your agent's key                                                            │
│                                                                              │
│  Your agent trades with a key of its own, made by Candle's CLI and stored    │
│  straight into the Candle Harness. It never shows on screen.                 │
│                                                                              │
│  ▸ name       agent-a▏                                                       │
│    runs on   Claude Code · sonnet, from step 2                               │
│                                                                              │
│  Candle's cap on the key, optional                                           │
│    cap        $50        a day · past it, Candle refuses buys and swaps · …  │
│                                                                              │
│  It runs, in the pane:                                                       │
│    candle keys create --label agent-a --tx-limit 50 --reset daily            │
│    no vault: approved by you in the pane                                     │
│    then your approval in the browser, if Candle asks                         │
│                                                                              │
│    Make the key                                                              │
│                                                                              │
